meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 装上后,宿主程序会新增 DeltaChat 渠道,通过邮箱收发加密消息。启动时自动配置邮箱账户、生成邀请链接和二维码;收到消息后自动建立会话并接到智能体,支持文件附件。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 DeltaChat、配置邮箱渠道,或要求把 DeltaChat 会话接到智能体时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 DeltaChat 邮箱渠道
say.note: 按安装流程添加渠道并重启服务。

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 的邀请链接和二维码给我
把 DeltaChat 群聊接到智能体

howto.what_en: After install, the host gets a DeltaChat channel for encrypted email messaging. On startup it configures the account, logs an invite link, and writes a QR SVG. Incoming messages are auto-routed to agents; attachments are supported.
howto.when_en: When you ask to add or integrate DeltaChat, configure an email channel, or connect a DeltaChat chat to an agent.

say_en.text: Set up the DeltaChat email channel for me.
say_en.note: Runs the installation and account configuration flow.

say_en.text: Show me the DeltaChat invite link and QR code.
say_en.note: The invite URL is in the startup log; QR is saved as an SVG.

say_en.text: Connect the DeltaChat group 'team-chat' to our agent.
say_en.note: Wires the messaging group to an agent group.
